quote: In Springfield, they're eating the dogs. The people that came in, they're eating the cats. They're eating — they're eating the pets of the people that live there.
speaker: Donald Trump
context: ABC News Presidential Debate in Philadelphia, PA
debunk: Springfield, Ohio Republican Mayor Rob Rue, the Springfield Police Division, City Manager Bryan Heck, and Ohio Republican Governor Mike DeWine all publicly verified that there were zero credible reports, police calls, or evidence of Haitian immigrants harming or eating neighborhood pets or park wildlife. Snopes confirmed the viral rumor originated from third-hand neighborhood Facebook gossip that was later retracted.

quote: Can you imagine you're a parent and your son leaves the house and you say, 'Jimmy, I love you, have a good day in school' and your son comes back with a brutal operation? The school decides what the child should be.
speaker: Donald Trump
context: Moms for Liberty National Summit in Washington, D.C.
debunk: Major pediatric medical associations, including the American Academy of Pediatrics, and state education boards confirm that no U.S. school performs surgical operations of any kind on children. Gender-affirming surgeries are complex hospital procedures requiring extensive clinical evaluations, multi-year psychiatric counseling, and explicit parental consent.

quote: He said, the baby will be born and we will decide what to do with the baby. In other words, he will execute the baby.
speaker: Donald Trump
context: CNN Presidential Debate in Atlanta, GA
debunk: Former Virginia Gov. Ralph Northam (a pediatric neurologist) was describing tragic end-of-life palliative care in cases of severe fetal abnormalities or congenital deformities incompatible with life. Northam's remarks addressed medical comfort care if a nonviable infant was delivered, not execution. Infanticide is strictly illegal under federal and state homicide laws.

quote: Kamala spent all her FEMA money, billions of dollars, on housing for illegal migrants, many of whom should not be in our country. Now we have a hurricane and they have no money.
speaker: Donald Trump
debunk: FEMA's Disaster Relief Fund (DRF) is legally restricted by Congress strictly for natural disaster victims and cannot be repurposed. The migrant sheltering program (Shelter and Services Program) was a completely separate budget line item directly appropriated by Congress and administered by Customs and Border Protection without drawing a single cent from disaster accounts.

quote: They're offering them 50 to people whose homes have been washed away, while sending hundreds of billions of dollars to foreign countries.
speaker: Donald Trump
context: Campaign Rally in Fayetteville, North Carolina
debunk: The 50 Serious Needs Assistance is an upfront, instant emergency stipend meant for immediate essentials like drinking water, food, and baby supplies while displaced. It is not a cap on relief; disaster survivors remain eligible for tens of thousands of dollars in home repair grants, temporary rental assistance, and SBA disaster loans.

quote: A tariff is a tax on a foreign country. That's the way it is, whether you like it or not. A lot of people say, 'Oh, it's a tax on us.' No, no, no. It's a tax on a foreign country. China pays hundreds of billions of dollars.
speaker: Donald Trump
context: Economic Policy Address in Asheville, North Carolina
debunk: Bipartisan analyses from the Congressional Budget Office (CBO), U.S. International Trade Commission, and leading trade economists confirm that tariffs are customs duties assessed on U.S. registered importers (American companies) upon entering U.S. ports. These costs are overwhelmingly passed down to American consumers in the form of higher retail prices.

quote: Nobody has spoken to crowds bigger than me. If you look at Martin Luther King, when he did his speech, his great speech, and you look at our crowd on the Mall on January 6th, we had more people. They said he had a million people, but I had more.
speaker: Donald Trump
context: Mar-a-Lago Press Conference in Palm Beach, Florida
debunk: Archival photographic evidence and National Park Service records document that approximately 250,000 people attended the historic 1963 March on Washington for Dr. Martin Luther King Jr.'s speech at the Lincoln Memorial. Official event permits and House January 6 Committee records show Trump's crowd at the Ellipse was approximately 53,000—less than one-quarter of MLK's crowd.

quote: Nancy Pelosi was in charge of security. She turned down 10,000 soldiers and National Guardsmen. Look at the information, she said, 'I take full responsibility for January 6th.'
speaker: Donald Trump
context: Campaign Rally in Concord, New Hampshire
debunk: The Speaker of the House does not command the D.C. National Guard; statutory command authority over the D.C. Guard belongs exclusively to the President of the United States and the Secretary of Defense. The bipartisan Senate Homeland Security and House investigations concluded there was never any presidential order for 10,000 troops, and Pelosi had no authority to reject one.

quote: REPORT: DOMINION DELETED 2.7 MILLION TRUMP VOTES NATIONWIDE. DATA ANALYSIS FINDS 221,000 PENNSYLVANIA VOTES SWITCHED FROM PRESIDENT TRUMP TO BIDEN. 941,000 TRUMP VOTES DELETED.
speaker: Donald Trump
debunk: The Department of Homeland Security's CISA agency, 59 preeminent computer voting security researchers, and statewide hand-audits of physical paper ballots (including Georgia's full recount of 5 million ballots) verified that voting systems counted ballots with 100% accuracy. Dominion Voting Systems subsequently secured a landmark 87.5 million defamation judgment against networks promoting these claims.

quote: Alabama will most likely be hit (much) harder than anticipated. Under certain original scenarios it was in fact 100% that Alabama would be hit.
speaker: Donald Trump
context: White House Oval Office Briefing on Hurricane Dorian
debunk: During an Oval Office briefing, Trump displayed an official National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration (NOAA) track that had been visibly extended with a black Sharpie marker to encompass Alabama. The National Weather Service in Birmingham had already released an urgent statement clarifying: 'Alabama will NOT see any impacts from #Dorian. We repeat, no impacts from Hurricane Dorian will be felt across Alabama.'

quote: If you have a windmill anywhere near your house, congratulations, your house just went down 75% in value. And they say the noise causes cancer. You tell me that one, okay?
speaker: Donald Trump
context: National Republican Congressional Committee Spring Dinner
debunk: The American Cancer Society, peer-reviewed medical journals, and state public health agencies have repeatedly confirmed there is zero scientific or biological mechanism by which acoustic sound from wind turbine blades can induce cancerous cellular mutations or tumors. Wind turbine noise levels at typical setbacks are comparable to light background traffic.

quote: I see the disinfectant, where it knocks it out in a minute, one minute. And is there a way we can do something like that, by injection inside or almost a cleaning? Because you see it gets in the lungs and it does a tremendous number on the lungs, so it'd be interesting to check that.
speaker: Donald Trump
context: White House Coronavirus Task Force Press Briefing
debunk: Though Trump later insisted his comments were sarcastic, his televised remarks at the official White House podium prompted immediate emergency alerts from the FDA, CDC, and disinfectant manufacturers like Reckitt Benckiser (makers of Lysol) warning that injecting or ingesting disinfectant products is extremely dangerous and causes severe poisoning, organ failure, and death.

quote: Crime is through the roof, at levels never seen before. We have migrant crime. It's a new category of crime, and it's more violent than anything you've ever seen.
speaker: Donald Trump
debunk: Official FBI Uniform Crime Reporting statistics, Bureau of Justice Statistics, and nonpartisan criminological institutes show that violent crime across the United States dropped to near 50-year historic lows in 2023 and 2024, with homicides declining by double digits. Extensive research by Stanford, CATO, and the National Institute of Justice demonstrates that undocumented immigrants commit violent crimes at lower rates than native-born citizens.

quote: One of the presidents of a big country stood up and said, 'Well, sir, if we don't pay and we're attacked by Russia, will you protect us?' I said, 'You didn't pay? You're delinquent?' He said, 'Yes, let's say that happened.' 'No, I would not protect you. In fact, I would encourage them to do whatever the hell they want. You got to pay your bills.'
speaker: Donald Trump
context: Campaign Rally in Conway, South Carolina
debunk: NATO member nations do not pay membership fees, protection dues, or bills to the United States or to NATO. The alliance guidelines ask member states to invest at least 2% of their own GDP into their own national military budgets. There are no unpaid invoices or debt balances that make a sovereign NATO country 'delinquent.'

quote: Toyota and Honda are closing manufacturing plants across America because of our tariffs, and they're going to suffer big penalties.
speaker: Donald Trump
context: White House Trade Briefing and Truth Social Post
debunk: Financial filings and official statements from Toyota Motor North America and Honda confirmed that neither automaker shuttered any U.S. plants. To the contrary, both firms had actively invested billions of dollars in new domestic assembly lines and battery facilities in Indiana, Ohio, Kentucky, and North Carolina.

quote: Nobody has died in the Iran war... This war, seven months, 18 people killed. That includes Venezuela, 18. Eighteen is too many, but nobody has died compared to what was predicted.
speaker: Donald Trump
debunk: Trump uttered the literal statement that 'nobody has died' in military actions involving Iran, but immediately conceded moments later in the same interview that 18 U.S. service members had in fact lost their lives in overseas operations, directly contradicting his opening claim.

quote: They're emptying out their insane asylums, their mental institutions, and their prisons from all over the world into the United States. Venezuela's crime is down 72% because they sent their criminals to America.
speaker: Donald Trump
context: Republican National Convention Keynote in Milwaukee, WI
debunk: Fact-checking investigations and independent criminological monitors in South America found zero evidence that any government opened prison gates or psychiatric facilities to send populations northward. The drop in Venezuelan crime is documented by international observers as the result of economic collapse, broad family emigration, and local gang territorial agreements.

quote: I know nothing about Project 2025. I have no idea who is behind it. I have nothing to do with them. I disagree with some of the things they're saying and some of the things they're saying are absolutely ridiculous and abysmal.
speaker: Donald Trump
debunk: At least 140 former Trump administration staffers, including six cabinet secretaries (such as OMB Director Russ Vought, Ben Carson, and Chad Wolf) author-crafted Project 2025's policy book. Archival video from 2022 also documented Trump personally sharing a flight with Heritage President Kevin Roberts and explicitly heralding Heritage's project: 'They're going to lay the groundwork and detailed plans for exactly what our movement will do.'
